verdict.rationale: The API paths carry a version prefix (`/v1/tasks/{id}`, `POST /v1/text_to_video`), and Workflows can be published as versioned endpoints, so some API versioning is visible. Nothing in the evidence documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or how versions evolve, so only the versioning half of the story is glancingly supported. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy, explicit versioning scheme docs (e.g. version headers, changelog, compatibility guarantees), and independent corroboration.
